purpose: Separate cold-start quota convergence from steady offered load, then map workload and failure mechanism regions without selecting cells or seeds by outcome.

common_rules.primary_denominator: all workflows in the preregistered cohort times all common probes

cold_start_and_steady_state.initial_alpha_basis: checked-in default and checked-in minimum; not selected from outcome magnitude
cold_start_and_steady_state.control_window_basis: one-third, registered default, and twice default
required_outputs: per-window active serving GiB, Peer-HBM backup GiB, headroom GiB, queue integral, alpha, releases, and dispatches
cold_start_and_steady_state.note: The steady cohort is fixed before execution and retains backlog created during warmup; no first-30-second deletion or post-hoc truncation is allowed.

workload_failure_region.scientific_basis: crosses feasible low/medium/high active-serving HBM demand with registered 8K/16K/40K context and the two supported source failure domains
workload_failure_region.statistics: paired-seed mean, Student-t 95% CI, per-seed paired policy difference; no seed filtering

stop_rule: Run and report the complete registered matrices even if AegisKV remains slower; do not expand or suppress cells based on sign or significance.
